observations: DocumentSnapshot currently uses fields 1..3; candidate manifest field 4 is append-only.
OperationPayload currently uses oneof fields 1..15; candidate update_resource_manifest field 16 is unused.
The frozen operation registry currently defines ids/tags 1..15 only.
OperationKind is inferred from the payload variant index and currently accepts 1..15; reserving 16 requires accepted P13 registry and implementation review.
No accepted ResourceKind registry source was found for Image=1, Font=2, Brush=3 or the 4..255 reservation.
ADR-0013 requires kind validation but does not assign these numeric values.
checks.required_resolution: P12/P13 Authority must bind a versioned ResourceKind registry path and exact values before implementation.

observations: The candidate proposes a SHA-256 product digest stream.

The accepted G1 plan explicitly says digest algorithm/width must come from current authority; when product digest is not frozen, G1 uses projection bytes plus verification-only SHA-256 and makes no product compatibility promise.
The current g1_06 verification tool uses FNV-1a 64 for verification projection comparison, not a product Document digest authority.
checks.required_resolution: P12/P13 must either bind an accepted product digest algorithm/byte stream or remove the product digest claim and defer it to the owning authority.

observations: ADR-0020 requires the same atomic checkpoint to bind Document revision, RecoveryFrontier, digest algorithm/version and digest, but current snapshot.proto has no accepted fields for those bindings.
checks.required_resolution: Freeze the exact Snapshot revision/frontier/digest representation and field ownership before claiming atomic manifest binding.
